name: SizeAgainstObjects
job: Show a product's real size as clean outlines beside everyday objects (hand, mug, phone) drawn to scale from its dimensions, with a toggle to swap the comparison object, so shoppers grasp size without reading centimetres
visitor_action: tap an object chip to change the comparison (arrow keys move between chips); hover or focus the product or object to see exact dimensions
owner_settings: Comparison objects (choose up to 4 from hand, mug, phone, bank card, can, A4 sheet, each with its label)
mobile: readout stacks above the drawing, plot fills the width, segmented control scrolls sideways with an edge fade
motion: ruler wipes in along the baseline, product drops onto it as its contact shadow settles, the comparison object's construction box appears then its outline traces, details and hatching follow, dimension lines grow from their centres and the size numbers count up; switching objects fades the old drawing, springs the scale (ruler ticks re-scale, product lifts slightly and lands) and the segmented thumb slides (reduced-motion: static, scale snaps)

checks.render: pass (fixes: matte filter region made an opaque box; narrow readout overlapped the plot; product reflection read as a pale column, removed)
checks.craft: pass (4 after 1 polish round: worst-case labels capped, stronger contact shadow, spring morph verified)

provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Product lab: cool pale grey-blue ground with fine blueprint grid, photo product with real contact shadow, graphite technical line drawings with hatching, safety-orange architectural dimension lines, large sans tabular-numeral readout
notes: 2026-11-23: redesigned (batch A) to Product lab. Product photo is matted (white backdrop keyed out by luminance), so a light, tightly cropped photo works best.
